conclusion: InlongSlicer application-version checks are disabled. PresetUpdater::version_check_enabled() is false; GUI_App::check_new_version_sf returns before HTTP, and normal/forced update-event handlers suppress release dialogs. The Help and command-palette update actions and stable-only preference are removed. Profile and plugin synchronization retains its independent existing behavior. The current Release was rebuilt and its CLI loaded successfully with all832 current user settings files restored exactly and byte-identical slicing core/Clipper libraries. No interactive GUI session was used for verification.
